text:
incident-bot: pager fired for service=inference-gateway region=us-west1 alert=5xx_rate_spike threshold=3% current=12.4% window=2m link=<https://pagerduty.example/INC12345|INC12345> :rotating_light:

mira: acked. pinging oncall. seeing spike from ~11:24 -> correlates with large customer batch jobs?

sam: looking at logs now — high 502/504 from upstream kv-cache nodes, connection resets and 503s behind LB.

-devon: adding context — traffic spike from /v1/generate route, client_id=acme-inc, qps up x8. Possible thundering herd from a retry loop.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 acknowledged by mira (oncall: mira). Escalation timer set 15m.

mira: quick triage — mitigation options: 1) temporarily route acme-inc to dedicated fallback pool; 2) enable proxy circuit-breaker for kv-cache; 3) scale inference-gateway up + reduce concurrency. Which is fastest?

sam: fastest is circuit-breaker on kv-cache (config change), then route traffic. I'll open a runbook step.

devon: sharing command to flip breaker on sidecar:
```bash
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/kv-proxy CIRCUIT_TRIP=true --record
```

mira: on it — applying now. I'll also add a header-based routing rule to divert client_id=acme-inc to fallback pool.

ops-lead: +1 to diversion. Please leave a short customer note after stable. Keep throttles conservative to avoid data loss.

sam: breaker applied, seeing connection resets drop in last 30s. 5xx rate down to 6.1% (1m window). continuing to monitor.

incident-bot: metric update: inference-gateway 5xx_rate=6.1% window=1m; request_rate down 18% for acme-inc after diversion.

mira: roll-forward plan: hold diversion 10m, if 5xx <2% restore route and remove breaker; if not, open a deeper postmortem.

devon: capturing quick logs for postmortem:
```
[11:24:12] upstream kv-proxy: conn reset by peer
[11:24:13] inference-gateway: retry loop detected client_id=acme-inc route=/v1/generate retry_count=4
```

mira: customer impact — partial degradation for acme-inc only, other customers unaffected. CS alerted to craft an advisory if we need prolonged diversion. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 annotated: mitigation=breaker+route-diversion, status=stabilizing.

sam: monitoring for 3 more minutes then will start controlled restore.

mira: thanks team — keep this thread for updates. Adding links to dashboards: <https://metrics.example/inference-gateway?from=-15m|gateway> and <https://logs.example/q=acme-inc|logs>.

ops-lead: nice triage. after-stabilize items: add retry-safety check in gateway, default backoff increase, and add acme-inc as canary candidate for future traffic surges.

incident-bot: thread closed automatically after stabilization window. last metric snapshot recorded at 9876500036.
